conditions.evidence: referred for PSG examination on the context of different sleep disorders
conditions.label: sleep disorders

output.population: 151 whole-night PSG recordings (85 Male, 66 Female, mean Age of 53.9 ± 15.4), a heterogeneous patient population referred for PSG examination for different sleep disorders, collected during 2018
output.summary: Whole-night polysomnographic sleep recordings from a Dutch sleep center, containing EEG, EOG, chin EMG and ECG traces with hypnogram sleep-stage annotations scored by sleep technicians.
